retryPolicy: zero; every prior start/result is excluded; quarantined unknown attempts remain unresolved
deduplication: Byte-identical messages under the same frozen model/protocol share one recorded call; not independent repeated samples.

receiptStorage.journal: sha256 JSON lines; sync before generation and after each recorded milestone
receiptStorage.commit: synced staging file, exclusive hard link, synced destination directory
receiptStorage.boundary: Admission check is not a disk reservation. Journal evidence is audit-only until validated; never resubmit a started input.

recovery.policy: Separately versioned cohort for audited never-attempted inputs only. Missing historical results/dispatch/usage remain unknown, never fabricated, retried, replaced or scored as successful. Any new failure stops this cohort; complete-run acceptance remains false.
